about.title: About
about.p1: I have been a full-stack developer at Sunsoft-Sunrise since 2020. I build the company's applications and deploy them to production on Linux servers, including projects for PSI Madagascar in the pharmacy sector.
about.p2: In 2024 I founded Xonobox, my independent studio. I deliver web and mobile apps to clients directly: a health mutual, a ride-hailing platform.
about.p3: My daily stack is Vue.js, NestJS and Flutter. I care about maintainable code: Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, unit tests.

efameno.trust: After the first phase, the client chose to keep working with Xonobox directly, with no intermediary, and has already asked for a third sprint.
